}}'''Mathematics''' is a tier three [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Catapult]], a long-ranged [[unit]] with a high attack but no defence, and the [[Sawmill]], a [[building]] that produces one [[population]] for every adjacent [[Lumber Hut]]. 

For [[Cymanti]], Mathematics unlocks the [[Exida]], a special unit that replaces the Catapult and deals splash poison damage, and the Sawmill.
